name: Plausible Analytics
tagline: Privacy-first web analytics. The Substack of Google Analytics replacements.
shortDescription: Lightweight (< 1 KB script), cookie-free, GDPR-compliant web analytics. No cookie banner needed. Open source, self-hostable, and a 5-minute managed cloud setup. Used by 12,000+ paying subscribers.
longDescription:
## What it is

Plausible is a privacy-first alternative to Google Analytics. The tracking script is under 1 KB, it does not set any cookies, and it does not collect any personal data — so you can drop the cookie banner entirely. The dashboard shows the metrics you actually care about: unique visitors, page views, bounce rate, visit duration, top pages, top sources.

## Why we recommend it

It is the most-loved Google Analytics alternative in the indie/SaaS community for good reason. The script is 45x smaller than GA, the interface is dramatically simpler, and the team is independent and transparent. Self-hosting is a single Docker container; the managed cloud is $9/mo for 10K monthly pageviews.

## When to use it

- Any site that needs analytics but wants to drop the cookie banner
- Indie/SaaS marketing sites (Plausible integrates with Stripe for revenue tracking)
- Sites worried about GDPR / CCPA compliance
- Anyone tired of GA4's 200-page interface
installInstructions:
**Managed (easiest):** Sign up at https://plausible.io — 30-day free trial, then $9/mo for 10K pageviews. Add one script tag to your site.

**Self-host:**
1. `git clone https://github.com/plausible/analytics && cd analytics`
2. `cp .env.example .env` and fill in `BASE_URL` and `SECRET_KEY_BASE`
3. `docker compose up -d`
4. Open `http://localhost:8000` and create your account
5. Add the script tag to your site: `<script defer data-domain="yourdomain.com" src="https://your-plausible.com/js/script.js"></script>`
pricingDetails: Self-host: free, you pay for hosting. Cloud: $9/mo (10K pageviews), $19/mo (100K), $49/mo (1M). No per-event or per-visitor fees.
